GOVERNED (`skills/**`) ⇒ draft PR, in-seat review, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge, `skip-changeset`; at ACCEPT the seat adds `needs-user-decision` + the 维护者速读. The PR carries `Fixes #16324`.
